measurementContract.axePrivacyAndManualReview: Axe violations and incomplete results retain sanitized rule, selector, check, and node detail. Raw node HTML and check data are omitted. Incomplete results are reported for manual review and are not automatically treated as violations.
measurementContract.deterministicScreenshots: Each desktop-large chamber screenshot waits on the settled-shot gate and disables animations during capture for deterministic pixels.
